title: Amsterdam · Veluwe Forest and IJssel River
slogan: A 215 km loop out of Naarden fortress
story: Forest lanes and river dikes without city clutter. A 215 km loop that starts and ends near Naarden, about 3 h 42 of riding. The stops in between: Veluwe forest roads, Deventer river stop and IJssel dike roads. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows. The plan has 1 food stop marked.

sections.advice: Amsterdam start → Naarden fortress is the reward section in Amsterdam. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

Use Veluwe forest roads → Deventer river stop as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: This Deventer river stop → IJssel dike roads stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
